we propose a method to label a hierarchy of topologically coherent clusters generated from a collection of textual documents.

(1) the hierarchical clustering algorithm proposed by the authors can be effectively used to generate a hierarchy from a set of documents, (2) betweenness centrality is effective in generating descriptive labels for clusters, (3) keyphrase extraction and title generation are useful in labeling clusters, and (4) the proposed cluster labeling method generates better labels than the baselines.

the problem of automatically organizing and labeling textual documents into a hierarchy, which can help users to better understand the documents and to find the relevant information more efficiently.
the problem of organizing a large number of documents into a hierarchy and giving the clusters descriptive labels to ease browsing and retrieval.
